name: Maxakalisaurus
sum: Maxakalisaurus is a titanosaur from the Adamantina Formation of Minas Gerais, Brazil, found in 1998.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MN 5013-V, with a fragmentary maxilla with teeth, twelve cervical and seven dorsal vertebrae with ribs, and sacral and other parts.
material: Holotype plus a lower jaw and teeth referred later.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Kellner et al. 2006
